*PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life*
**Job Description**
 This practice is built for the way enterprise software
 *actually* 
 gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to shape, design and build those solutions. Working alongside Product Strategists and Data Engineers, you'll take products from discovery through deployment, combining technical depth with a practical understanding of what clients need to achieve. On some engagements, we continue to run what we've built, giving you the opportunity to stay close to the product and see the impact of your work long after go\-live.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. Most of the code here is written by agents. That does not make this a supervision job. It moves the engineering upstream, where strong engineering judgment becomes even more important. You'll write code, review agent\-generated outputs, and shape the architecture, controls and acceptance criteria that determine whether a solution succeeds in production. Requirements do not always arrive fully formed, and part of the role is helping define the problem while continuing to move delivery forward.
   

  

**As part of the Digital Products \& AI team, you can expect to:**
* Architect the elements that determine whether AI solutions succeed in production, including tool selection, memory and context management, guardrail design, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Build and deploy the technical components that power agentic systems, including retrieval pipelines, MCP services and integrations, and the systems that connect AI capabilities to enterprise data and processes.
* Modernize platforms and applications around current business needs, rebuilding where necessary rather than simply moving legacy functionality onto newer technology.
* Design security and operational resilience into solutions from the start, including access controls, identity management, deployment guardrails, and oversight of automated actions.
* Break down complex problems into deliverable components, helping shape scope, sequencing, and implementation approaches that enable rapid delivery.
* Create reusable patterns, skills, and tooling that strengthen future engagements and contribute to the growth of the capability.


**Qualifications**
 You have a track record of designing, building, and delivering complex technology solutions in production environments. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work.
   

  

**To Be Successful, You'll Have**
* Engineering foundations
+ Experience building and operating production software. Client\-facing technical delivery experience is expected at senior levels.
+ Strong software engineering skills, ideally including Python and TypeScript.
+ Experience designing and delivering cloud\-native systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* AI engineering
+ Hands\-on experience building AI applications and agent\-based systems in production. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies, and the judgment to know when an orchestration layer earns its complexity.
+ Experience building retrieval\-enabled systems and working with technologies such as pgvector, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch, with an understanding of the trade\-offs between retrieval quality, latency, and cost.

* Enterprise delivery
+ Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems, data platforms, APIs, identity providers, and MCP\-enabled services.
+ Strong technical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while working directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams, balancing delivery speed with quality, security, and long\-term maintainability.


**Ideally, You'll Also Bring**
* Experience delivering solutions within consulting, professional services, or time as a technical founder.
* Experience in healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, or consumer industries.
* Experience building reusable platforms, tooling, or AI solutions in regulated environments.

 ShellMate brings SSH, SFTP, AWS Systems Manager (SSM), terminals, Docker, databases, Redis, logs, Git, and other infrastructure tools into a unified desktop workspace.  We’re looking for a technically strong engineer who wants to solve challenging problems at the intersection of backend engineering, infrastructure automation, security, and AI\-powered operations.
   




 Role Description
 
 This is a full\-time, remote Backend Engineer role focused on building and improving the core systems behind ShellMate.
 



 You will design, develop, and maintain reliable backend services and infrastructure integrations using Rust and Go. You’ll work on security\-sensitive execution workflows, infrastructure connectivity, distributed operations, and the backend systems that support ShellMate’s AI\-powered SRE capabilities.
 



 You will also contribute to the design of AI agent execution systems, tool orchestration, approval and authorization policies, and investigation workflows that help engineers diagnose real\-world infrastructure problems safely.
 



 This role is hands\-on and engineering\-focused. You’ll participate in architecture decisions, write production\-quality code, review implementations, investigate difficult technical issues, and improve system performance, security, and reliability.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 * Design, implement, and maintain backend services using Rust and Go.
* Build reliable infrastructure integrations for SSH, SFTP, AWS SSM, Docker, databases, and other operational tools.
* Develop secure command\-execution workflows with appropriate authentication, authorization, approval controls, and auditability.
* Build and improve AI\-powered infrastructure investigation and SRE workflows, including tool orchestration, evidence gathering, failure handling, and controlled remediation.
* Design robust APIs, asynchronous processing, and concurrent systems that remain reliable under real\-world operating conditions.
* Implement security\-conscious credential handling and help maintain ShellMate’s zero\-trust and zero\-knowledge security architecture.
* Improve observability, error handling, performance, testing, and production reliability.
* Collaborate on technical architecture, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD improvements.
* Investigate complex bugs across backend services, desktop integrations, and infrastructure environments.
* Take ownership of technical problems from investigation through implementation, testing, and production verification.


 Required

* Professional experience with
 **Rust and/or Go** 
 , with a solid understanding of concurrency, error handling, testing, and performance optimization.
* Strong fundamentals in operating systems, Linux, networking, processes, and system\-level debugging.
* Experience with API design, databases, asynchronous operations, and reliable service architecture.
* Practical understanding of authentication, authorization, secure coding, and sensitive\-data handling.
* Experience with Git, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate issues across multiple system components.

**About Zadar Labs** 




 At Zadar Labs, we are redefining perception for intelligent systems through high\-resolution imaging radar and AI\-driven sensing technologies. Our mission is to enable machines to perceive and understand the world more reliably across autonomous systems, robotics, industrial automation, smart infrastructure, and public safety applications.
 



  





 We are looking for a highly motivated Radar Perception and Sensor Fusion Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team and help build next\-generation perception software platforms.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Radar Perception and Sensor Fusion Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy algorithms for radar perception and sensor fusion, translating mathematical concepts and experimental prototypes into reliable, real\-time software.
 



  





 You will own algorithm development from problem definition and prototyping through quantitative validation, production implementation, and deployment. Your work will include object detection, clustering, multi\-object tracking, sensor fusion, and real\-time processing pipelines.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a highly capable software engineer with strong C\+\+ and Python skills, practical mathematical foundations, and demonstrated algorithm development experience. We are looking for someone who can formulate a problem, evaluate alternative approaches, understand their assumptions and limitations, and improve solutions through experimentation with real sensor data.
 



  





 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams across perception, robotics, AI, embedded systems, and DevOps to deliver robust production\-grade solutions. The role involves collaboration with multicultural and globally distributed teams, partners, and customers across different regions and technical domains.
 



  





**Compensation: $130,000 \- $170,000** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Software and Algorithm Development** 



* Design, develop, test, validate, and maintain software modules and algorithms across the perception and robotics stack.
* Develop scalable and maintainable real\-time software systems using C\+\+ and Python, with ROS / ROS2 where appropriate.
* Design and improve algorithms for radar perception, sensor fusion, object detection, clustering, and multi\-object tracking.
* Analyze recorded and live sensor data to identify failure modes, investigate underlying causes, and improve algorithm performance.
* Apply probabilistic estimation and data association methods, such as Kalman filters, to perception problems.
* Build robust APIs, middleware layers, and processing pipelines for perception systems.
* Optimize software and algorithms for accuracy, robustness, computational cost, and real\-time latency.
* Develop tools for debugging, visualization, logging, replay, and performance evaluation.
* Define evaluation metrics and reproducible tests; validate algorithms using recorded datasets, simulation, and real\-world testing.
* Work across Linux\-based development environments and embedded platforms.



  





**CI/CD and Infrastructure** 



* Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated testing infrastructure.
* Maintain build, release, and deployment systems.
* Debug integration and regression issues across software modules.
* Work closely with engineers to improve software quality, reliability, and scalability.
* Maintain dashboards, reports, and software health monitoring systems.



  





**System Integration and Deployment** 



* Integrate perception software and algorithms with radar sensors, cameras, GPS/IMU systems, and embedded computing platforms.
* Support deployment on NVIDIA Jetson, ARM\-based systems, and edge AI devices.
* Develop and maintain Docker\-based development and deployment workflows.
* Support software packaging, release management, and deployment automation.
* Assist with field testing and debugging of deployed systems.



  





**Minimum Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills in C\+\+ and Python.
* Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating algorithms in perception, robotics, signal processing, computer vision, estimation, or a related field.
* Strong foundations in linear algebra, probability, and statistics, with the ability to apply them to practical engineering problems.
* Ability to formulate problems, compare algorithmic approaches, analyze failure cases using data, and validate improvements quantitatively.
* Experience translating algorithm prototypes into tested, maintainable software.
* Experience with Linux environments, Git\-based workflows, and software debugging and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and multithreaded or real\-time systems.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to investigate unfamiliar technical problems.



  





**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)** 



* Experience with radar perception, radar\-camera or IMU fusion, or other sensor\-based perception systems.
* Experience with state estimation, filtering, data association, point\-cloud processing, or geometric reasoning.
* Experience working with noisy sensor measurements and validating algorithms in real\-world conditions.
* Experience with ROS / ROS2, OpenCV, or PCL.
* Experience with embedded Linux, NVIDIA Jetson, ARM\-based systems, or other edge computing platforms.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD systems, and simulation\-based testing.
* Experience with SLAM or localization.
* Exposure to AI/ML\-based perception and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

* Collaborate with a highly experienced and multidisciplinary engineering team

 The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed.  The Implementation / ML Ops Engineer is responsible for implementing, deploying, and supporting AI/ML models within approved GPU\-enabled environments. This role packages and operationalizes trained models, supports scalable data and deployment pipelines, integrates models with production systems, and helps maintain reliable monitoring, validation, versioning, and rollback processes. The engineer works within established enterprise patterns, security controls, and AI governance standards while collaborating with product, technology, and business partners to deliver production\-ready AI capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implements model monitoring and evaluation techniques to improve AI system performance over time
* Ensures AI solutions adhere to governance, security, and compliance requirements
* Provides support and troubleshooting for AI models and data processing pipelines in production
* Collaborates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives
* Performs standard tasks within established procedures and guidelines; works within established guidelines with some degree of independence for routine tasks
* Develops and integrates components of production AI systems, including ML models or LLM\-based services, with moderate independence
* Applies enterprise standards for observability, safety, and compliance in implemented AI components
* Implements and supports model packaging, validation, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback using approved templates and controls.
* Contributes to CI/CD, container, Kubernetes, registry, testing, and telemetry configurations for assigned workloads.
* Troubleshoots common implementation issues and escalates complex design, optimization, or production problems to senior engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Education and Knowledge**
* 2\+ years software development, including hands\-on experience in machine learning, AI technologies, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
* Knowledge of Python and data processing technologies
* Working knowledge of machine learning techniques and model evaluation approaches
* Foundational working knowledge of MLOps or LLMOps, containers, Kubernetes fundamentals, CI/CD, artifact management, testing, and monitoring.
* Basic understanding of GPU resource needs, runtime dependencies, scheduling constraints, and enterprise security and change controls.


**Work Experience**
* Experience in working with large language models (LLMs), especially GPT\-3\.5/4 or similar AI models
* Experience in languages such as Python or R
* Experience in deploying AI models and pipelines using machine learning operations tools
* Experience in continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and containerized deployments
* Experience developing and deploying machine learning or LLM\-enabled applications in production or near\-production environments
* Practical experience with distributed systems concepts, APIs, and cloud\-native infrastructure supporting AI workloads
* Moderate expertise in a specific technical domain
* Some practical experience contributing to software, infrastructure, container, data, or machine learning deployment and automation work.
* Exposure through project, internship, or practical work to containerized deployment, artifact repositories, automated testing, monitoring, versioning, or rollback.

 About Hussh
 



  





 Hussh is two businesses with one mission: make information — especially private personal information — a real financial asset for the human it belongs to, with the human in control of every machine, always.
 



  





 The technology company builds private personal AI: Private Agent One (a personal agent that works only for its human, on consent), iMoney (the money app — investing rebuilt with the human approving every move), the puppy home supercomputer, and the Aloha books. The asset\-management company runs permanent capital on one doctrine — own the world's fastest growers of absolute free cash flow — starting with Fund A, live now.
 



  





 We are 100% privately owned and profitable — founder\-funded, no outside investors — three people in the US today plus our India team and our research lab with IIT Kharagpur. Forward\-deployed engineering is led by our co\-founder, Kushal Trivedi. We build like we work at Apple: excellence, experience, and ease of use, all three, every ship. You are the bet in the field: AI in the biggest manner, the best supercomputers we can build, in customers' homes and institutions — carried there partner\-first and distributor\-first, because that is literally your job. Every deployment must create value, deliver value, and turn that value into shareholder equity for everyone who works with us, invests with us, or does business with us. Brand, culture, and values walk into every customer room with you, weighted the same as the product.
 



  





 The role
 



  





 Mission: take the core stack into the real world — and bring the field's truth back into the product.
 



  





 Forward\-deployed engineers sit with customers, partners, and institutions and ship in the field: a family office's Private Agent One install, a retail partner's puppy fleet, an RIA's iMoney rollout, a partner's developer\-platform integration. The puppy line takes orders October 31, 2026 — your deployments make those orders real. You are an engineer first: you build, you integrate, you debug at the customer's side — and every deployment teaches the platform something, because you carry the lesson home.
 



  





 You will be one of the first 3–5 FDEs, on Kushal's founding team, working directly with the CEO.
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





 \- Own deployments end to end: scoping with the customer, integration, go\-live, and the first hard week after.
 



 \- Build the deployment playbooks as you go — the second deployment of anything should be boring because the first one's lessons are written down.
 



 \- Feed field truth into the core platform weekly: what customers actually need, where the product lies to them, what to fix first.
 



 \- Integrate with partner platforms and APIs (our partnership pipeline is active — developer\-platform integrations are live work, not roadmap items).
 



 \- Hold the bar in the field: a deployment that works at demo quality is not done. Done is the customer trusting it.
 



  





 What success looks like in 6 months
 



  





 \- The first puppy deployments are live and loved — customers who bought \*and\* stayed.
 



 \- Private Agent One and iMoney rollouts at partner institutions run on your playbooks.
 



 \- The core team's roadmap visibly carries field truth: fixes and features that trace to your deployments.
 



 \- Partners ask for you by name.
 



  





 What you bring — musts
 



  





 \- 4\+ years of engineering with real systems shipped to real users — you can debug production, read a stack trace at a customer's whiteboard, and write the fix yourself.
 



 \- Full\-stack range: APIs, data, deployment, and enough infrastructure depth to be dangerous in the right direction.
 



 \- The human instinct: you like sitting with a customer until it works. Technical depth \*plus\* patience \*plus\* warmth — the aloha mindset, applied to engineering.
 



 \- Ownership under ambiguity: in the field, the spec is incomplete and the deadline is real. You have shipped anyway, without shipping junk.
 



  





 Nice to have
 



  





 \- Forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or field engineering experience (Palantir\-style FDE, or equivalent).
 



 \- Financial\-services or advisor\-tech deployments (RIA, family office, wealth platforms).
 



 \- Hardware\-adjacent deployment experience — devices in homes and offices, not just cloud.
 



  





 What we offer
 



  





 $160,000–$220,000 base with deployment\-milestone bonuses, and a founding equity grant on a 4\-year vest — founding\-grade ownership for founding work, in a company that is 100% privately owned and profitable. Founding titles here are permanent. You will know every customer by name, ship every week, and build the deployment motion every future FDE at this company will learn from.
 



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Apply here on LinkedIn with your resume and a short note answering one question: tell us about a deployment you owned that almost failed — what you did in the room, and how it ended: what shipped, and what it delivered, in numbers if you have them.
